playerState.hint: A deterministic 3–5 gameweek view. Current role and availability lead; history provides context and market activity has no weight.

playerState.outputProcessHint: FPL returns and real-match process validate each other; disagreement is shown as Mixed, not averaged away.
playerState.availabilityRoleHint: Official FPL availability is authoritative. Starts and minutes describe the current role.
playerState.outlookHint: Official FPL fixtures and FDR, with every DGW fixture and explicit BGWs.
playerState.baselineHint: The latest three eligible seasons use normalized 55/30/15 weights; historical peers require {minutes}+ minutes.

playerState.historyStorageUnavailable: Historical FPL evidence is temporarily unavailable because the sealed archive cannot currently be read.
playerState.careerHint: Percentiles are calculated inside each season and official FPL position; raw values are never mixed across eras.

playerState.careerProcessUnavailable: Historical real-world process is withheld until this player has season-specific verified provider links.
playerState.historyCoverageUnavailable: Historical tables are not yet ready for a sealed, verified player baseline. One limitation is shown here instead of rendering empty baseline and career sections.

reason.availabilityUnavailable: Official FPL status says the player is unavailable.
reason.availabilityDoubtful: Official FPL status carries an availability doubt.
reason.availabilityAvailable: Official FPL status currently lists the player as available.
reason.availabilityUnknown: No current official availability snapshot is available.
reason.roleSecure: Started at least four of the last five with a 70+ minute median.
reason.roleManaged: The recent role is managed rather than fully secure.
reason.roleAtRisk: Recent starts or starter minutes put the role at risk.
reason.roleMinutesVolatile: Recent playing time has varied materially.
reason.roleInsufficientWindow: Too few covered gameweeks exist to rate the current role.
reason.roleImproving: The recent role has strengthened versus the prior window.
reason.roleDeclining: The recent role has weakened versus the prior window.
reason.outputStrong: Current FPL output is in the strong position percentile band.
reason.outputTypical: Current FPL output is in the typical position percentile band.
reason.outputWeak: Current FPL output is in the weak position percentile band.
reason.outputInsufficient: Current FPL output cannot yet be rated.
reason.outputRising: Recent FPL output is at least 15 percentile points above baseline.
reason.outputFalling: Recent FPL output is at least 15 percentile points below baseline.
reason.outputStable: Recent FPL output remains inside the neutral band.
reason.processUnavailableUnderstat: Verified current Understat process is unavailable; no process claim is made.
reason.processMetricCapabilityUnavailable: The published provider data cannot support every required process metric.
reason.processGkpTeamContextOnly: Goalkeepers receive team defensive context, not a fabricated individual process grade.
reason.historyProven: At least two eligible seasons sit within a 20-point percentile span.
reason.historyVariable: Eligible historical seasons vary by more than 20 percentile points.
reason.historyEmerging: Current minutes are meaningful, but fewer than two eligible historical seasons exist.
reason.historyInsufficient: There is not enough eligible sealed history for a reliability label.
reason.outlookFavourable: At least three fixtures are FDR 2 or easier and there is no blank.
reason.outlookDifficult: The five-GW window has at least three hard fixtures or a blank.
reason.outlookNeutral: The official fixture window is neither clearly favourable nor difficult.
reason.outlookDgw: The window contains a double gameweek.
reason.outlookBgw: The window contains a blank gameweek.
reason.outputUpProcessDown: FPL output is rising while real-world process is falling.
reason.outputDownProcessUp: FPL output is falling while real-world process is rising.
reason.rolePerformanceConflict: Role movement conflicts with current output or process.
reason.outputProcessUp: FPL output and real-world process are rising together.
reason.outputProcessDown: FPL output and real-world process are falling together.
reason.signalsStable: The effective current signals remain inside their neutral bands.
reason.roleOutputConflict: Recent role and FPL output point in opposite directions.
reason.fplOutputUp: FPL-only evidence shows a material output rise.
reason.fplOutputDown: FPL-only evidence shows a material output decline.
reason.currentFplInsufficient: Current-season FPL evidence is not mature enough for a trend.
reason.trendWithheldBacktest: The directional headline is withheld because sealed-season walk-forward testing did not produce a reliable Rising–Stable–Falling order.
reason.trendWithheldCrossProviderBacktest: The cross-provider headline is withheld until verified Understat data passes its own walk-forward test.
reason.fplOnly: No verified current process is available, so confidence is capped at Low.
reason.smallSample: Current process has only 180–449 minutes and is marked as a small sample.

labels.processUnavailable: Verified current Understat process is unavailable; no process claim is made.
labels.processGkpTeamContextOnly: For goalkeepers, Understat is limited to team defensive context; no individual process grade is shown.

TournamentHelp.title: Competition help
TournamentHelp.participantsOne: Fetch a league from an official fantasy.premierleague.com league URL.
TournamentHelp.participantsTwo: Official selection includes every fetched entry; Custom lets you choose a subset.
TournamentHelp.participantsThree: At least two entries are required before creation.
TournamentHelp.formatOne: The current competition type is Standard.
TournamentHelp.formatTwo: Use no group stage or a points-race group stage, then optionally add single or double elimination.
TournamentHelp.formatThree: The summary shows the team and round counts calculated from your choices.
TournamentHelp.scheduleOne: Group-stage gameweeks must be in order and within the 38-gameweek season.
TournamentHelp.scheduleTwo: When enabled, the knockout phase starts after the selected group-stage window.
TournamentHelp.scheduleThree: The form prevents creation when the knockout rounds would run past gameweek 38.
TournamentHelp.createOne: The competition name is checked before submission.
TournamentHelp.createTwo: After creation, the page reports whether setup is ready, processing, or needs attention.
TournamentHelp.createThree: You can view the competition when creation succeeds.
TournamentHelp.editQuestion: Can I edit a competition after creating it?
TournamentHelp.editAnswer: Competition owners can update the name or delete the competition from its management page.
TournamentHelp.fetchQuestion: Why must I fetch a league first?
TournamentHelp.fetchAnswer: The fetched league supplies the real FPL entry IDs used by the competition. Custom selection changes which fetched entries are included.
TournamentHelp.scheduleQuestion: How is the knockout schedule calculated?
TournamentHelp.scheduleAnswer: The form calculates the required rounds from the qualifying entries and elimination format, then places them after the group stage.
TournamentHelp.processingQuestion: What if setup is still processing?
TournamentHelp.processingAnswer: The competition shell opens immediately. Setup continues in the background and the page updates when standings are ready.
TournamentHelp.capabilityDescription: Create, view, rename, pause, resume, roster sync, retry, and delete are supported. Competition rules stay immutable.
